Taxonomic notes: There are two commonly recognized subgenera in the Grape Family (Vitaceae). The subgenus Vitis, includes the majority of species in the family. The subgenus Muscadinia includes two species: Vitis rotundifolia, including its varieties, and Vitis popenei (Flora of North America 2016). Some authors (e.g., Weakley et al. 2020) elevate subgenus Muscadinia to the rank of genus (Wen et al. 2018). Subgenus Muscadinia differs from subgenus Vitis in having simple tendrils, larger fruits, seeds with longer ventral infolds, and 40 chromosomes rather than 38 (Wen et al. 2018).
